mechanics.claim: Darkness Rise's on-hit bonus damage is a separate proc-damage instance from the basic attack, while the aura is persistent area damage.
mechanics.quote: ''Darkness Rise'' deals {{tip|persistent area damage}} damage around '''Mordekaiser''', while the bonus damage on his basic attacks is {{tip|proc damage}}.

mechanics.claim: The on-hit bonus damage does not apply to structures.
mechanics.quote: ''Darkness Rise's'' bonus damage {{tip|on-hit}} is not applied against {{tip|structures}}.

mechanics.claim: Abilities generate a stack on hit even if they deal no damage (e.g. against invulnerable targets or spell shields).
mechanics.quote: '''Mordekaiser''' will still generate ''Darkness Rise'' stacks from hitting his abilities even if they deal no damage, such as if the target is {{tip|invulnerable}} or blocks an ability with a {{tip|spell shield}}.

mechanics.claim: Basic attacks do not generate a stack if the attack is dodged, blocked, or missed while blinded.
mechanics.quote: Basic attacks do not generate a stack if their damage event does not happen due to the target being {{tip|invulnerable}}, or the attack being {{tip|dodge|dodged}}, {{tip|block|blocked}}, or missed while '''Mordekaiser''' is {{tip|blind|blinded}}.

mechanics.claim: Darkness Rise's aura damage alone does not refresh the Darkness Rise buff duration.
mechanics.quote: ''Darkness Rise's'' area damage alone does not refresh ''Darkness Rise's'' buff.
